scope: Layoffs & Job Destruction Level-4 canonical factors

definitions.A_DIRECT_OBS: An official agency publishes the measurement directly.
definitions.B_CALC: A deterministic AUXSAYS calculation from accepted official observations.
definitions.C_EVENT_OR_STRUCTURAL: A legitimate factor represented through official events, structural tables, or another non-conventional series.
definitions.D_TAXONOMY_OR_SOURCE_PROBLEM: The concept is too broad, duplicative, misleading, or unsupported and must not be forced into production. Classification never promotes an observation or relationship.

factors.rationale: BLS CES publishes the total-private average weekly hours observation directly.
The Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts publishes business bankruptcy filing counts directly in Table F-2.
BLS BED publishes jobs lost at contracting establishments directly; Census BDS provides a separately governed annual counterpart.
Census BDS publishes firm-death counts directly.
BLS BED and Census BDS publish gross job-loss/job-destruction measurements directly with separately governed cadence and adjustment semantics.
BLS JOLTS publishes the hires rate directly.
DOL ETA publishes national initial unemployment-insurance claims directly.
BLS JOLTS publishes the job openings rate directly.
BLS JOLTS publishes both the layoffs-and-discharges level and rate directly.
BLS CPS publishes the permanent-job-losers estimate directly.
BLS CES publishes temporary help services employment directly.
BLS CPS publishes the job-losers-on-temporary-layoff estimate directly.
Federal Reserve H.15 publishes official borrowing-rate observations directly once the intended instrument and maturity are selected.
factors.promotionBlocker: Exact H.15 instrument and maturity are not selected.

factors.rationale: Stress is not an official observation; it requires a governed deterministic transformation of accepted business-bankruptcy filings.
factors.promotionBlocker: No accepted normalization window or materiality profile.

factors.rationale: The label ambiguously mixes legal filings, firm deaths, closures, and financial distress, which are not interchangeable official measurements.
factors.promotionBlocker: Narrow or replace the concept before source selection.

factors.rationale: Census Business Formation Statistics publishes explicitly defined formation statistics directly.
factors.promotionBlocker: Credential, rights, retrieval, and observation acceptance are pending.

factors.rationale: Dynamism combines official entry, exit, or formation components and must disclose its formula and scope.
factors.promotionBlocker: No accepted component set or calculation contract.

factors.rationale: The concept duplicates or ambiguously combines C&I lending standards, loan demand, rates, and terms.
factors.promotionBlocker: Canonicalize to a specific SLOOS question or separately governed calculation.

factors.rationale: The Federal Reserve SLOOS publishes respondent-weighted lending-standard results directly for specified borrower classes.
factors.promotionBlocker: Exact borrower class, question wording, and vintage selector are pending.

factors.rationale: The Federal Reserve SLOOS publishes respondent-weighted C&I loan-demand results directly for specified borrower classes.
factors.promotionBlocker: Exact borrower class, question wording, and vintage selector are pending.

factors.rationale: Federal Reserve G.17 publishes capacity-utilization rates directly for defined aggregates and industries.
factors.promotionBlocker: Exact aggregate and G.17 series selector are pending.

factors.rationale: Consumer demand is a broad latent concept and is not interchangeable with PCE or retail sales.

factors.rationale: BEA publishes personal consumption expenditures directly under defined NIPA concepts.
factors.promotionBlocker: Exact NIPA table, line, price basis, units, and vintage are pending.

factors.rationale: Profitability is a ratio rather than the same measurement as corporate profits.
factors.promotionBlocker: Numerator, denominator, sector scope, and formula are not accepted.

factors.rationale: BEA publishes corporate-profits estimates directly.
factors.promotionBlocker: Exact NIPA table, line, adjustment, and vintage are pending.

factors.rationale: FEMA and NOAA publish event and declaration records rather than a single economic observation.

factors.rationale: Official event evidence requires a governed geographic and temporal join before operational relevance can be claimed.
factors.promotionBlocker: No accepted geographic/temporal exposure join.

factors.rationale: NOAA publishes weather-event records, not an economy-wide shock index.

factors.rationale: BLS BED publishes jobs lost at closing establishments directly.

factors.rationale: BLS BED and Census BDS publish direct, non-interchangeable establishment-death or exit measures.

factors.rationale: Firm age and size are structural classification dimensions rather than one scalar state.

factors.rationale: Vulnerability requires a deterministic comparison of accepted BDS cohort observations.

factors.rationale: Industry import exposure must be calculated from trade observations and an authoritative trade-to-industry allocation.

factors.rationale: Growth is deterministically calculated from accepted CES payroll-employment levels.
